This is the program for the Community Events.

Overture Community Meetup will be held during FOSS4G 2026 Hiroshima as an informal session hosted by the Overture Maps Foundation. The session will introduce Overture’s free and open global datasets and ID reference system.

Participants will have the opportunity to ask questions, join hands-on demos and activities, and learn more about Overture Maps.

---

Event Details

Date : August 31 , 2026, 14:00 PM to 16:00 PM

Planned venues : RCC Bunka Center Room701(5-11 Hashimoto-cho, Naka-ku, Hiroshima City, Hiroshima Prefecture)

Participation :  Open to participants interested in Overture Maps, open global datasets and hands-on demos



You can also find more information about the Community Events below.
https://2026.foss4g.org/en/program-schedule/community-events/
